sources.information: The official Roskilde Festival homepage identifies the festival, shows its 2027 dates, reports that RF27 ticket sales are underway, and announces the first 18 programme acts.
The official festival page describes Roskilde Festival as an eight-day music and culture festival in Roskilde and gives confirmed 2027 dates of June 26–July 3.

The official RF27 ticket page lists a full-festival ticket for DKK 2,650, a two-day ticket for DKK 2,230, and single-day tickets for Wednesday through Saturday at DKK 1,530 each; listed prices include the ticket fee.
The official contact page lists the festival-time address as Festivalpladsen, Darupvej 19, 4000 Roskilde, and links the festival’s Instagram and Facebook accounts.
